rules.title: Allowable Annual Rent Increase
rules.citation: SF Rent Ordinance (referenced in SF.gov rates page)
rules.quote: Allowable Rent Increase: 1.6% for March 1, 2026 – February 28, 2027
rules.summary: The allowable annual rent increase in San Francisco is limited to 1.6% for the period from March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027.

rules.title: Security Deposit Interest Rate
rules.citation: SF Rent Ordinance (referenced in SF.gov rates page)
rules.quote: Security Deposit Interest: 4.2% for March 1, 2026 – February 28, 2027
rules.summary: Security deposits in San Francisco must earn interest at a rate of 4.2% for the period from March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027.

rules.title: Relocation Payments for Owner/Relative Move-in, Demolition, or Capital Improvement Evictions
rules.quote: Relocation Payments for Evictions based on Owner/Relative Move-in OR Demolition/Permanent Removal of Unit from Housing Use OR Temporary Capital Improvement Work* OR Substantial Rehabilitation
rules.summary: Tenants evicted for owner or relative move-in, demolition, permanent removal from housing use, temporary capital improvement work, or substantial rehabilitation are entitled to relocation payments of $8,245 per tenant, up to $24,733 per unit, plus $5,497 for each elderly, disabled tenant, or household with minor children for eviction notices served March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027.
rules.key_value: $8,245.00 per tenant, max $24,733.00 per unit, plus $5,497.00 for elderly/disabled/minor children

related_citations.evidence: The amount of relocation payments for temporary capital improvement evictions for less than 20 days is governed by California Civil Code Section 1947.9 and not by Rent Ordinance Section 37.9C.

rules.coverage_text: Applies to evictions based on Owner/Relative Move-in OR Demolition/Permanent Removal of Unit from Housing Use OR Temporary Capital Improvement Work OR Substantial Rehabilitation

rules.title: Relocation Payments for Ellis Act Evictions
rules.quote: Relocation payments for tenants evicted under the Ellis Act
rules.summary: Tenants evicted under the Ellis Act are entitled to relocation payments of $11,110.05 per tenant, up to $33,330.13 per unit, plus $7,443.90 for each elderly (62 or older) or disabled tenant for eviction notices served March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027.
rules.key_value: $11,110.05 per tenant, max $33,330.13 per unit, plus $7,443.90 for elderly/disabled
rules.coverage_text: Applies to evictions under the Ellis Act

rules.title: Relocation Payments for Temporary Displacement Less Than 20 Days
rules.quote: Relocation payments for temporary displacement for less than 20 days
rules.summary: Tenants temporarily displaced for less than 20 days are entitled to relocation payments of $446 per day plus actual moving expenses for eviction notices served March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027.
rules.coverage_text: Applies to temporary displacement for less than 20 days
